FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (B-COMMWS-123, agent 123) — growth-project-backend#753 @ d5cdf747e4e5442929a911a9a96d44f74bd6021f

Job F6 (ops/lanes123/JOBS123.md), B-E2E-1 from S-E2E-CLIENT-123, operator decision D1 = (a). Mobile companion: growth-project-mobile#389.

**What changed (385 changed lines, 60 of them src)**
1. `src/community/community.repository.ts` `ensureWorkspaceForCoach`: when the coach owns no live space, upsert the workspace on `slug = coach-<coachId>` (name "Community") and the cohort on `workspace_id_name` ("All members", sort_order 0), the clinic seed's shape. Upserts on unique keys only, no retry machinery. An existing owned space is reused; an archived one is not revived.
2. `src/community/community.service.ts` `getMe`: a coach gets `ensureWorkspaceForCoach(user.id)`; a client with `coach_id` and no membership gets `ensureWorkspaceForCoach(coach_id)` and then the existing bootstrap.
3. `src/community/posts/community-posts.service.ts` `canCreatePost`: owner, workspace coach **or any active, unbanned member** (it was coach-only). Without this, (1) and (2) still end in 403 `community.post.client_posts_disabled` for every client post in the Hall and Cohorts (the scout sketch missed the coach-only gate), so the job's acceptance "client can post (201)" needs it. The Apple 1.2 filter, report and block already apply to posts, and clients already write comments and cohort messages. **Operator decision D-F6-1** (default (a)): keep this; (b) revert this hunk plus e2e test 2, and hide the client composer CTA in the app instead.

**Tests**
- `test/community/community-me-auto-provision.spec.ts` (new; real service + repository over an in-memory Prisma): 3 of 4 fail on main (client gets `workspace_id: null`), 4 of 4 pass here (local single-file run through ops/heavy.sh).
- `test/community/community-posts.e2e.spec.ts` (live DB): 2 = an active member's post returns 201 (was 403); 2b = a client of a coach with no space gets `workspace_id` + membership on `/me`, the space is `coach-<id>` / "Community" / one "All members" cohort, repeat and coach `/me` reuse it (count 1), the client posts 201, another coach's client gets 404. community-live-tests: 129 of 129 passed, none skipped (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37416038597/job/112114743793).

**CI**: all checks green at this head (build-and-test, community-live-tests, rls-live-tests, danger, R75 banned casts, schema parity, CodeQL, audit); deploy-readiness-gate skipped as usual for PRs.

Cs: C-F6-2, the 403 `client_posts_disabled` body is now unreachable (kept for a future per-workspace toggle). C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): a coach whose space has zero active cohorts.

READY FOR AUDIT
